title: Eternal recurrence
idea: Imagine living your life again, exactly as it is, forever. If that fills you with dread, something needs to change.
apply: Look at a typical day this week and ask whether you would live it on repeat. Change one part of it.
remind: Live as if you would choose it again, forever.
who: Alex, who scrolls his phone every evening without noticing.

scenes.nar: Alex scrolls his phone for three hours every evening, without really noticing.

items.x: The same evenings, again and again

scenes.nar: Nietzsche proposed a test. Imagine your life repeating exactly as it is, forever. The same evenings, again and again. Would you say yes?
Alex realizes he would not choose his evenings on repeat. So he designs ones he would: cooking, guitar, and a call with a friend.
Within a month his evenings look different. They are ones he would happily live again.
